generations.imageAlt: Close-up of the new low chassis during assembly
generations.summary: A new low chassis, built from the ground up in our own lab. More soon.

generations.name: Generation 2
generations.imageAlt: Generation 2 race car with Intel NUC on the Traxxas chassis, on track at a RoboRacer Grand Prix
generations.summary: Same proven Traxxas chassis, with the onboard computer moved from a Jetson to an Intel NUC for more processing power.

generations.name: Generation 1
generations.imageAlt: Generation 1 race car with NVIDIA Jetson on the Traxxas chassis
generations.summary: Our first physical race car: a Traxxas chassis with an NVIDIA Jetson, raced up to and including London 2023.

timeline.title: Virtual Grand Prix win
timeline.text: First place at the IFAC Virtual Autonomous Grand Prix, raced entirely in simulation.

timeline.title: Generation 1 debut
timeline.text: Our first physical car, with a Traxxas chassis and NVIDIA Jetson, wins the 9th Grand Prix in Prague.

timeline.title: Podium in Philadelphia
timeline.text: Third place out of 38 teams at ICRA 2022.

timeline.title: Last race for Generation 1
timeline.text: Second place out of 41 teams at ICRA 2023 in London.

timeline.title: Generation 2 with Intel NUC
timeline.text: Same chassis, new onboard computer. Fourth in Yokohama, second in Abu Dhabi and first place in Milano.

timeline.title: Our own lab
timeline.text: Scuderia Segfault moves into the Autonomous Robots Lab of the Research Unit of Cyber-Physical Systems at TU Wien (Room PCEG13).
timeline.imageAlt: Sign of the Scuderia Segfault Autonomous Robots Lab, Room PCEG13, TU Wien

timeline.title: Hosting RoboRacer Vienna
timeline.text: We host the 27th RoboRacer Autonomous Racing Competition at TU Wien.

timeline.title: Generation 3
timeline.text: A new low chassis is in development in our lab.
